consumer_contract.note: Consumers declare the moving major channel in active dependency manifests and direct executable installs. A resolved commit belongs in a generated lockfile as reproducibility evidence, never in a manifest as the compatibility contract.

artifacts.note: No published artifact for 1.1.0; consumers install from the compatibility channel via git+https and hash-verify the resolved archive in their generated lock.

agreement_rules: release_tag must equal v{package_version} and must remain immutable once published
release_tag and compatibility_channel must resolve to the same released object
consumers must declare compatibility_channel — never the exact release tag, a branch, or a commit sha
a generated consumer lock may record the concrete resolved object; that object is execution evidence, not the compatibility contract
a consumer lock whose resolved object differs from the current compatibility_channel target is stale and fails the networked release-identity check
main, master, cryptoxdog/Gate_SDK, and arbitrary 40-character consumer refs are forbidden in active dependency surfaces

provenance.note: Non-authoritative audit evidence. No validator — in this repository or in any consumer — may treat these values as a required dependency identity.
provenance.superseded_consumer_pin_policy: l9.gate_sdk.release_identity_ledger.v1 required consumers to pin release_commit_sha 2b2f53a28a59bbfb2fa45f5eac32b722d802209a. That policy is retired by the version-governed contract above.
